description: Files a car rental request in North Cyprus for a person who has agreed to the car, dates, places, extras and total, using their own name, email and phone. The Kipra team confirms the request; until then it is not a confirmed booking. No payment is taken. An email asks the person for a photo of their driving licence and ID card or passport. A second driver is added on the booking page.

currency.description: Currency the person wants to see and pay in.

email.description: Where the booking details and document link are sent.

expected_total_eur.description: The total the person agreed to. A different current total is refused.

language.description: Language of the result and the booking link: 'tr' for Turkish, otherwise 'en'.

phone.description: Phone in international format, for example +905551112233.

pickup_at.description: Pickup date-time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', Cyprus local time, within the booking hours.

pickup_location.description: Where the car is handed over.

return_at.description: Return date-time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', after pickup_at, within the booking hours.

validate_only.description: true = run every check and file nothing: no request is created and no email is sent.

name: request_booking
title: Request a car booking
